args.query: ALTER TABLE participants ADD COLUMN age_group TEXT; SELECT participant_id, full_name, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob) AS age FROM participants;

UPDATE participants SET age_group = CASE WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) < 30 THEN 'Under 30' WHEN (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN '30-50' ELSE 'Over 50' END; SELECT age_group, COUNT(*) as count FROM participants GROUP BY age_group;

INSERT INTO results_summary (analysis_id, metric, condition, value, n, computed_at, author) SELECT NULL, 'Age Group Counts', NULL, count, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system' FROM (SELECT age_group, COUNT(*) as count FROM participants GROUP BY age_group);
